description:
Make the Elixir implementation more idiomatic OTP without deviating from pi-mono's design.

Five concrete changes identified in architecture review (see octo_pi.md):

1. Registry.dispatch/3 in Subscribers — atomic lookup+dispatch instead of lookup-then-iterate
2. Registry.dispatch/3 for TUI Events — same fix in the TUI fan-out path
3. Interactive → GenServer — the load-bearing refactor; replaces the recursive receive loop with handle_info/2, unlocks deferred replies via GenServer.reply/2
4. UIContext ref dance → GenServer.call — eliminate the manual make_ref/send/receive pattern in build_ui_context; follows from (3)
5. Supervise TUI children under one_for_all Supervisor — eliminate trap_exit + manual EXIT handling; shutdown/4 becomes Supervisor.stop/1; follows from (3)

Dependency graph:
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[1. Subscribers dispatch] --> E[done]
    B[2. TUI Events dispatch] --> E
    C[3. Interactive GenServer] --> D[4. UIContext refactor]
    C --> F[5. TUI child Supervisor]
    D --> E
    F --> E
```

What to leave alone: Dispatcher pure function, Task.Supervisor.async_stream for tools, Loop as Task, AbortRef via ETS, Subscribers sync/async split.
title: OTP idioms: Registry.dispatch, Interactive GenServer, TUI supervision
